_doc: The default board: the mod's own sponsors (added to EVERY board), the timing and the row order. It is also
the board for home clubs with no team board at grounds with no competition board (fallback competition +
timing       persistTime = seconds each row stays up, transitionTime = seconds of the wipe/fade between rows
order        how a board's rows are stacked: club (a team board's identity row), team, competition, mod (= the sponsors below)
competition  the competition board used when a team board names none, and for this default board
sponsors     the rows, in order, as ids in config/sponsors/sponsors.json. Every sponsor exists once there:
config/sponsors/<id>.png is its finished row, 2048x128 (16:1, the size of every stock LED row),
exactly as it shows on the LED. Edit it by hand (then mark the entry "manual": true), or change
its recipe in sponsors.json and run `install.py rows <id>`.
On most grounds a panel is wider per row than 16:1 (about 12:1), so art shows a little narrower than
drawn - the stock rows look the same.
